title: Senior Product Designer, AI Analytics
body:
About the role

Ema is building a new AI analytics product that lets operations leaders interrogate everything their AI employees do — outcomes, exceptions, cost, and quality — without writing a query. This is a new surface, and you would be the first designer on it.

What you'll do
· Own the design of the AI analytics product end to end, from problem discovery through launch.
· Work directly with the PM and founding engineers to define what this product is, not just how it looks.
· Design for dense, high-stakes enterprise data without making it feel like a BI tool.
· Partner with enterprise customers in banking and insurance to ground the work in real operational reality.

What we're looking for
· 8+ years designing software products, with meaningful time on enterprise or B2B products.
· Evidence of taking products from ambiguity to launch.
· Comfort with complex workflows and data-dense interfaces.
· Strong partnership with product and engineering.
· Based in Bangalore or willing to relocate.

Nice to have
· Experience designing AI or ML-driven product surfaces.
· Analytics, BI, or observability product experience.
